name: hud_ui_save_load_game_name_input_on_activate
description: HudUiSaveLoadGameNameInput::OnActivate refreshes the displayed save name, moves the cursor to the string end, and activates the numeric text input base.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4348b0 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4348b0 validates GetBuffer, Update(buffer), strlen via repne scasb, SetCursorPosition(length), and HudUiNumericTextInput::OnActivate.
The native save/load input smoke verifies activation preserves the buffer, moves the cursor to the end, and sets the numeric input active.
